snippet.title: Into The Mountain - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo of Into the Mountain released 

A cozy 2D platformer that slowly turns into something far more unsettling.

The game shifts between multiple perspectives and genres, gradually expanding into 3D atmospheric horror.

Explore the Peak of Tauema and uncover the mystery surrounding it, as a 12-year-old boy, Ed, is drawn into a events far beyond his comprehension.

Link of the itch.io page: https://goldenmonkey1.itch.io/into-the-mountain
